summary: 12 features and 1 fix across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: add auto-task request handling and validation (e4f731c)
  • prompts: add research investigation prompt templates (6eced5c)
  • claude-provider: add startup timeout for Claude Code CLI (e125d04)

HagiCode-org/web

  • signalr: enhance SignalR connection and events (81cbbc9)
  • config: add frontend config infrastructure (dcf44f2)
  • vault: improve vault management with enhanced UI (ae231f5)
  • proposal: enhance proposal creation workflow (ed36089)
  • session: improve session management with research integration (333ecda)
  • project-scope: add project scope filtering (563a4d3)
  • voice: enhance voice recognition with device management (6ba97bd)
  • research: add research flow feature (3740a69)
  • api: add new API models and services (7b12930)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • prompts: enforce UTF-8 without BOM in optimize proposal bundle (d1920c5)
